Understanding the formation enthalpy formula and ensuring correct total-energy extractions adds to the conceptual load. It lies between a standard tutorial and a fully custom method.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has four declared stages: reference energies, stoichiometric compounds, defect supercells, and formation enthalpy calculation. Each requires setting up distinct Quantum ESPRESSO inputs, running relaxations, and collecting energies. The orchestration involves multiple DFT runs and careful post-processing, but there is no fragile tooling or complex data assembly; it is a typical multi-step computational-science workflow.
